value.rationale: The five-vertex house is a canonical minimal mixed-cycle graph with an induced four-cycle and triangular roof outside prior basic graph families. Its full strong matching complex has an exact nontrivial homotopy type and simple-homotopy graph spine, plus a nontrivial rational involution action. This supplies a motivated exact benchmark and exposes a large homotopy-degree discrepancy from the already indexed ordinary Morse complex on the same graph; it is not merely a face count, arbitrary numerical sample, or a general theorem claimed without proof.
